company.name: Finku
company.shortDescription: Finku is a fintech company that offers personal finance for Indonesians.
company.description:
Finku is a financial application that offers a personal finance platform for all Indonesians. It helps Indonesian consumers manage their finances better through financial tools. The company's mission is to eliminate financial illiteracy in Indonesia so that all Indonesians can leverage the existing financial ecosystem and make better financial decisions.

Finku was founded in 2021 and is based in Jakarta, Indonesia

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,216,877 to $21,416,536, a 4.11x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
